# 259_R6FIX.10 — BL-111: `u6-stub-turn.fixture.json` never emitted to dist (run ledger)

- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/259_R6FIX.10__u6-fixture-dist.md` (run-time insert — BL-111,
  root-caused by 206_R6REC.3) · **Branch:** `stevevitali/r6fix-10-fixture` ·
  **Base:** `main` (`da10ab5f` — the 259 row-insert tip) · **Date:** 2026-11-11 ·
  **Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent
- **Scope:** the `U6.chat` leg resolves its committed stub-turn fixture at dist-runtime.
  Stage A only, **$0**, zero production mutations — the scheduled `journeys.yml` nightly
  going green is the deployed proof (recorded, not claimed); no leg dispatched, no preview.
- **Defect class:** committed harness defect — `r7legs.ts`'s `U6_CHAT` read the fixture as a
  `src/` sibling via `import.meta.url`, but `tsc -b` emits only TypeScript outputs → the
  emitted `dist/r7legs.js` resolved `dist/u6-stub-turn.fixture.json`, a file the build never
  writes → ENOENT in the nightly `U6_CHAT` arm (red since ~2026-11-06, run 43034547961).
  Not provenance, not a product leg — the leg body is unchanged.

## Root cause (reproduced, not inferred)

`packages/journeys/src/r7legs.ts` `U6_CHAT` (the `node packages/journeys/dist/cli.js` arm the
nightly runs after `pnpm --filter @rhema/journeys build`):

```ts
readFile(new URL("./u6-stub-turn.fixture.json", import.meta.url), "utf8")
```

Under `dist/` this URL is `packages/journeys/dist/u6-stub-turn.fixture.json`; `tsc -b` never
emits non-TS assets, so nothing is written there. Under vitest (esbuild over `src/`) the same
URL resolved `src/u6-stub-turn.fixture.json` — which existed — so the suite could never see
the failure: the defect only fires on the compiled path the cron executes.

## Fix — the sibling pattern (package-root `fixtures/`)

Every other non-TS leg asset in this package lives in `packages/journeys/fixtures/` —
`paid-fixture.md`, `planted-error-essay.md`, `planted-error-excerpt.md`, `golden-op-ed.md`,
`restore-eval-essay.md` — read by `steps.ts`/`provision-res1.ts` as
`join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "../fixtures/<name>")`. One level up resolves
to the same committed file from `src/` (vitest) and from `dist/` (the cron), so `tsc -b`
never has to emit it. The fix matches that pattern exactly:

- `git mv packages/journeys/src/u6-stub-turn.fixture.json packages/journeys/fixtures/` —
  the committed fixture content is byte-identical (the leg's stub input, never weakened).
- `r7legs.ts` — new exported `U6_STUB_TURN_FIXTURE` constant computing that path once at
  module scope; `U6_CHAT` hands it to `readFile` in place of the `import.meta.url` sibling
  URL. Exported so the pin test asserts the SAME computation the emitted module performs,
  not a re-derived copy. Nothing else in the leg moved: the three `page.route` stubs, the
  send/poll/progress/reply assertions, the empty-send negative, and the debited-footnote
  check are byte-for-byte the same.

## Judgement calls

- **Relocation over `resolveJsonModule` or a build copy step.** The ticket names all three;
  the package's own five-fixture convention (steps.ts/provision-res1.ts) is the nearest
  pattern and keeps journeys self-contained with zero build-graph changes. A `with
  { type: "json" }` import would also work but adds a new asset mechanism for one file; a
  copy step duplicates a second asset pipeline for the same single file.
- **The path is exported.** Keying the pin test on the exported constant asserts the exact
  path the emitted leg reads — a test that re-derives `../fixtures/…` could pass while the
  leg still reads the old sibling URL.
- **AGENTS.md gotcha 11 not re-added.** The defect-class note ("a non-TS asset read via
  `import.meta.url` never reaches `dist`") already exists on the sibling agent-docs branch
  (`stevevitali/r6doc-2-agentdocs`, PR #324 — 208_R6DOC.2's diff); duplicating it here would
  create a same-file merge hunk. The gotcha's prescribed remedies remain true — this fix
  exercises the "fixtures live outside `src/`" arm the package already used.
- **Spend: $0.** No browser leg dispatched, no paid arm, no deploy — local suite only.
